title: Finchley Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospitals, urgent care, hazards, and supply points for Finchley and surrounding districts.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always call 999 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-hour A&E Hospitals:
- Barnet Hospital: Wellhouse Lane, Barnet EN5 3DJ. Full 24-hour A&E. From Finchley Central Station: ~5 miles north along High Road / Great North Road (A1000) to Barnet Hill, or bus 263 north towards High Barnet.
- Royal Free Hospital: Pond Street, Hampstead NW3 2QG. 24-hour A&E. From East Finchley Station: ~3.5 miles south via Great North Road and Archway Road / Hampstead, or Northern line / bus 263 south towards Archway.
- Whittington Hospital: Magdala Avenue, Archway N19 5NF. 24-hour A&E. From East Finchley: ~2.5 miles southeast along A1 / Archway Road, or bus 263 direct.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Finchley Memorial Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Granville Road, North Finchley N12 0JE. From West Finchley Station: ~15 min walk east (~0.8 miles) along Granville Road. Handles minor injuries, burns, sprains, and fractures.

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- Dollis Brook flows south along the western edge of Finchley, joining Mutton Brook to form the River Brent; low-lying parklands and culvert access points carry high flash flood risk during severe downpours.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
- Pharmacies, hardware stores, and large grocery stores along Finchley High Road (North Finchley), Ballards Lane (Central Finchley), and High Road (East Finchley) supply emergency rations, water, and first-aid provisions.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
